v.t: Alif, Lam, Meem
v.l: Alif-Lam-Mim

v.t: These are the Verses of the Wise Book
v.l: Tilka 'Ayatu Al-Kitabi Al-Hakimi

v.t: A guide and a mercy for the righteous
v.l: Hudaan Wa Rahmatan Lilmuhsinina

v.t: Those who observe the prayer, and pay the obligatory charity, and are certain of the Hereafter
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yuqimuna As-Salaata Wa Yu'utuna Az-Zakaata Wa Hum Bil-'Akhirati Hum Yuqinuna

v.t: These are upon guidance from their Lord. These are the successful
v.l: Ula'ika `Ala Hudaan Min Rabbihim Wa 'Ula'ika Humu Al-Muflihuna

v.t: Among the people is he who trades in distracting tales; intending, without knowledge, to lead away from God’s way, and to make a mockery of it. These will have a humiliating punishment
v.l: Wa Mina An-Nasi Man Yashtari Lahwa Al-Hadithi Liyuđilla `An Sabili Allahi Bighayri `Ilmin Wa Yattakhidhaha Huzuan 'Ula'ika Lahum `Adhabun Muhinun

v.t: And when Our Verses are recited to him, he turns away in pride, as though he did not hear them, as though there is deafness in his ears. So inform him of a painful punishment
v.l: Wa 'Idha Tutla `Alayhi 'Ayatuna Walla Mustakbiraan Ka'an Lam Yasma`ha Ka'anna Fi 'Udhunayhi Waqraan Fabashirhu Bi`adhabin 'Alimin

v.t: As for those who believe and do good deeds—for them are the Gardens of Bliss
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Lahum Jannatu An-Na`imi

v.t: Dwelling therein forever. The promise of God is true. He is the Mighty, the Wise
v.l: Khalidina Fiha Wa`da Allahi Haqqaan Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu

v.t: He created the heavens without pillars that you can see, and placed stabilizers on earth lest it shifts with you, and scattered throughout it all kinds of creatures. And from the sky We sent down water, and caused to grow therein of every noble pair
v.l: Khalaqa As-Samawati Bighayri `Amadin Tarawnaha Wa 'Alqa Fi Al-'Arđi Rawasiya 'An Tamida Bikum Wa Batha Fiha Min Kulli Dabbatin Wa 'Anzalna Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fa'anbatna Fiha Min Kulli Zawjin Karimin

v.t: Such is God’s creation. Now show me what those besides Him have created. In fact, the wicked are in obvious error
v.l: Hadha Khalqu Allahi Fa'aruni Madha Khalaqa Al-Ladhina Min Dunihi Bali Az-Zalimuna Fi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: We endowed Luqman with wisdom: “Give thanks to God.” Whoever is appreciative—is appreciative for the benefit of his own soul. And whoever is unappreciative—God is Sufficient and Praiseworthy
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Luqmana Al-Hikmata 'Ani Ashkur Lillahi Wa Man Yashkur Fa'innama Yashkuru Linafsihi Wa Man Kafara Fa'inna Allaha Ghaniyun Hamidun

v.t: When Luqman said to his son, as he advised him, “O my son, do not associate anything with God, for idolatry is a terrible wrong.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qala Luqmanu Liabnihi Wa Huwa Ya`izuhu Ya Bunayya La Tushrik Billahi 'Inna Ash-Shirka Lazulmun `Azimun

v.t: We have entrusted the human being with the care of his parents. His mother carried him through hardship upon hardship, weaning him in two years. So give thanks to Me, and to your parents. To Me is the destination
v.l: Wa Wassayna Al-'Insana Biwalidayhi Hamalat/hu 'Ummuhu Wahnaan `Ala Wahnin Wa Fisaluhu Fi `Amayni 'Ani Ashkur Li Wa Liwalidayka 'Ilayya Al-Masiru

v.t: But if they strive to have you associate with Me something of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. But keep them company in this life, in kindness, and follow the path of him who turns to Me. Then to Me is your return; and I will inform you of what you used to do
v.l: Wa 'In Jahadaka `Ala 'An Tushrika Bi Ma Laysa Laka Bihi `Ilmun Fala Tuti`huma Wa Sahibhuma Fi Ad-Dunya Ma`rufaan Wa Attabi` Sabila Man 'Anaba 'Ilayya Thumma 'Ilayya Marji`ukum Fa'unabbi'ukum Bima Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: “O my son, even if it were the weight of a mustard-seed, in a rock, or in the heavens, or on earth, God will bring it to light. God is Kind and Expert
v.l: Ya Bunayya 'Innaha 'In Takun Mithqala Habbatin Min Khardalin Fatakun Fi Sakhratin 'Aw Fi As-Samawati 'Aw Fi Al-'Arđi Ya'ti Biha Allahu 'Inna Allaha Latifun Khabirun

v.t: O my son, observe the prayer, advocate righteousness, forbid evil, and be patient over what has befallen you. These are of the most honorable traits
v.l: Ya Bunayya 'Aqimi As-Salaata Wa 'Mur Bil-Ma`rufi Wa Anha `Ani Al-Munkari Wa Asbir `Ala Ma 'Asabaka 'Inna Dhalika Min `Azmi Al-'Umuri

v.t: And do not treat people with arrogance, nor walk proudly on earth. God does not love the arrogant showoffs
v.l: Wa La Tusa``ir Khaddaka Lilnnasi Wa La Tamshi Fi Al-'Arđi Marahaan 'Inna Allaha La Yuhibbu Kulla Mukhtalin Fakhurin

v.t: And moderate your stride, and lower your voice. The most repulsive of voices is the donkey’s voice.”
v.l: Waqsid Fi Mashyika Wa Aghđuđ Min Sawtika 'Inna 'Ankara Al-'Aswati Lasawtu Al-Hamiri

v.t: Do you not see how God placed at your service everything in the heavens and the earth? How He showered you with His blessings, both outward and inward? Yet among the people is he who argues about God without knowledge, without guidance, and without an enlightening Scripture
v.l: Alam Taraw 'Anna Allaha Sakhkhara Lakum Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Wa 'Asbagha `Alaykum Ni`amahu Zahiratan Wa Batinatan Wa Mina An-Nasi Man Yujadilu Fi Allahi Bighayri `Ilmin Wa La Hudaan Wa La Kitabin Munirin

v.t: And when it is said to them, “Follow what God has revealed,” they say, “Rather, we follow what we found our parents devoted to.” Even if Satan is calling them to the suffering of the Blaze
v.l: Wa 'Idha Qila Lahumu Attabi`u Ma 'Anzala Allahu Qalu Bal Nattabi`u Ma Wajadna `Alayhi 'Aba'ana 'Awalaw Kana Ash-Shaytanu Yad`uhum 'Ila `Adhabi As-Sa`iri

v.t: Whoever submits himself wholly to God, and is a doer of good, has grasped the most trustworthy handle. With God rests the outcome of all events
v.l: Wa Man Yuslim Wajhahu 'Ila Allahi Wa Huwa Muhsinun Faqadi Astamsaka Bil-`Urwati Al-Wuthqa Wa 'Ila Allahi `Aqibatu Al-'Umuri

v.t: Whoever disbelieves—let not his disbelief sadden you. To Us is their return. Then We will inform them of what they did. God knows what lies within the hearts
v.l: Wa Man Kafara Fala Yahzunka Kufruhu 'Ilayna Marji`uhum Fanunabbi'uhum Bima `Amilu 'Inna Allaha `Alimun Bidhati As-Suduri

v.t: We give them a little comfort; then We compel them to a harsh torment
v.l: Numatti`uhum Qalilaan Thumma Nađtarruhum 'Ila `Adhabin Ghalizin

v.t: And if you ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They will say, “God.” Say, “Praise be to God.” But most of them do not know
v.l: Wa La'in Sa'altahum Man Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Layaqulunna Allahu Quli Al-Hamdu Lillahi Bal 'Aktharuhum La Ya`lamuna

v.t: To God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. God is the Rich, the Praised
v.l: Lillahi Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi 'Inna Allaha Huwa Al-Ghaniyu Al-Hamidu

v.t: If all the trees on earth were pens, filled by the ocean, with seven more oceans besides, the Words of God would not run out. God is Majestic and Wise
v.l: Wa Law 'Annama Fi Al-'Arđi Min Shajaratin 'Aqlamun Wa Al-Bahru Yamudduhu Min Ba`dihi Sab`atu 'Abhurin Ma Nafidat Kalimatu Allahi 'Inna Allaha `Azizun Hakimun

v.t: Your creation and your resurrection are only as a single soul. God is Hearing and Seeing
v.l: Ma Khalqukum Wa La Ba`thukum 'Illa Kanafsin Wahidatin 'Inna Allaha Sami`un Basirun

v.t: Have you not seen how God merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night? That He subjected the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term? And that God is Cognizant of everything you do
v.l: Alam Tara 'Anna Allaha Yuliju Al-Layla Fi An-Nahari Wa Yuliju An-Nahara Fi Al-Layli Wa Sakhkhara Ash-Shamsa Wa Al-Qamara Kullun Yajri 'Ila 'Ajalin Musammaan Wa 'Anna Allaha Bima Ta`maluna Khabirun

v.t: That is because God is the Reality, and what they worship besides Him is falsehood, and because God is the Exalted, the Supreme
v.l: Dhalika Bi'anna Allaha Huwa Al-Haqqu Wa 'Anna Ma Yad`una Min Dunihi Al-Batilu Wa 'Anna Allaha Huwa Al-`Aliyu Al-Kabiru

v.t: Have you not seen how the ships sail through the sea, by the grace of God, to show you of His wonders? In that are signs for every persevering, thankful person
v.l: Alam Tara 'Anna Al-Fulka Tajri Fi Al-Bahri Bini`mati Allahi Liyuriyakum Min 'Ayatihi 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Likulli Sabbarin Shakurin

v.t: When waves, like canopies, cover them, they call upon God, devoting their religion to Him. But when He has delivered them to dry land, some of them waver. No one renounces Our revelations except the treacherous blasphemer
v.l: Wa 'Idha Ghashiyahum Mawjun Kalzzulali Da`aw Allaha Mukhlisina Lahu Ad-Dina Falamma Najjahum 'Ila Al-Barri Faminhum Muqtasidun Wa Ma Yajhadu Bi'ayatina 'Illa Kullu Khattarin Kafurin

v.t: O people! Be conscious of your Lord, and dread a Day when no parent can avail his child, nor can a child avail his parent, in anything. The promise of God is true. Therefore, do not let this life deceive you, nor let illusions deceive you regarding God
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu Attaqu Rabbakum Wa Akhshaw Yawmaan La Yajzi Walidun `An Waladihi Wa La Mawludun Huwa Jazin `An Walidihi Shay'aan 'Inna Wa`da Allahi Haqqun Fala Taghurrannakumu Al-Haya Atu Ad-Dunya Wa La Yaghurrannakum Billahi Al-Gharuru

v.t: With God rests the knowledge of the Hour. He sends down the rain, and He knows what the wombs contain. No soul knows what it will reap tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die. God is All-Knowing, Well-Informed
v.l: Inna Allaha `Indahu `Ilmu As-Sa`ati Wa Yunazzilu Al-Ghaytha Wa Ya`lamu Ma Fi Al-'Arhami Wa Ma Tadri Nafsun Madha Taksibu Ghadaan Wa Ma Tadri Nafsun Bi'ayyi 'Arđin Tamutu 'Inna Allaha `Alimun Khabirun
